messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: High error rate detected on rerank pipeline (service=rerank-batch-v1). Alerts: 502/500 spikes, ~18% error rate over last 3m. Primary symptom: 'Invalid vector size' exceptions from reranker workers. Logs attached: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1954321987/*.

alice_oncall: I'm on it. Initial triage: looks like batch endpoint started returning 500s around 2026-02-14T15:12:xxZ. Can folks avoid changes to model images while we triage?

carol_sre: Noted. Pulling recent deploys and infra events. Any customer-impact notes yet?

eva_support: Support queue: 4 customers reported degraded relevance (ranked results staled / empty) starting ~15:13 UTC. No PII exposed. Ticket IDs linked in the incident board.

ben_ml: Quick hypothesis: embedder vector dimensionality mismatch. The reranker expects 1024-d vectors but we deployed a quantized embedder variant earlier this morning that might output 768-d vectors for certain code paths. Searching logs for 'vector length' now.

frank_eng: Reproduced locally: when a batch contains mixed-sized vectors we hit an assertion in the batched matrix multiply layer. Error snippet from worker logs:
```
ERROR reranker.worker: AssertionError: expected vector length 1024, got 768
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/reranker/serve.py", line 221, in handle_batch
    assert vectors.shape[-1] == CONFIG.EMBED_DIM
AssertionError: expected vector length 1024, got 768
```

carol_sre: Thanks. Can we route traffic to fallback instance that uses single-request path (non-batched) to reduce blast radius? That will increase cost but reduce customer impact.

alice_oncall: Can we flip the routing? frank_eng, ben_ml, can you confirm compatibility of fallback endpoint? I can trigger a routing rule if ready.

frank_eng: Fallback (rerank-single-v1) accepts variable-length vectors and will pad/normalize on the fly, so safe. Caveat: slower per-request latency. Recommend temporary route for 30% of traffic to start. Command to update routing policy (internal):
```
# update routing percentage
redwoodctl routing set --service rerank --policy fallback:30 --reason "mitigation: vector-dim mismatch"
```

alice_oncall: Doing the change now.

incident-bot: Routing change applied by alice_oncall at 2026-02-14T15:21:03Z. New policy: rerank -> fallback 30% for 1h. Monitoring... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

eva_support: Noticed error rate drop to ~9% within 2m after routing change; clients still seeing some failures for large batched jobs.

ben_ml: Digging into model registry: embedder v3.7.1 (deployed 15:05 UTC) has optional quantize path that returns 768 dims for low-memory workers; rollout % shows 40% of embeds served by v3.7.1. That matches timing. Hypothesis A: v3.7.1 introduced an unintended fallback that changes output dim for certain shards. Hypothesis B: batching code incorrectly assumes uniform dims and doesn't validate before stacking.

frank_eng: Found a deploy job 15:04 by ci/cd:tagger pipeline for embedder:v3.7.1 -> rollout=40%. Reverting rollout to 0% should stop new mismatched vectors.

alice_oncall: Please revert the embedder rollout. frank_eng / ben_ml, do it and confirm.

ben_ml: Reverting now: `model-registry rollout set embedder v3.7.1 --pct 0` -> succeeded at 15:25:41Z.

incident-bot: Model rollback event recorded (user=ben_ml, ts=2026-02-14T15:25:41Z).

carol_sre: After rollback and routing change, error rate down to ~1.5% over last 5m. Looks like rollback + fallback stopped bulk failures.

alice_oncall: Great. Triage checklist (in-thread):
- [x] Confirmed error cause signals (vector length mismatch)
- [x] Applied temporary routing fallback (30%)
- [x] Rolled back suspect embedder rollout (v3.7.1 -> 0%)
- [ ] Collect full traces + sample failed batches for RCA (owner: frank_eng)
- [ ] Customer impact summary (owner: eva_support)
- [ ] Postmortem doc + action items (owner: dave_pm)

frank_eng: Grabbing failed batch payloads and stack traces now. I put examples in s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1954321987/failed_batches/ and added a small script to filter by vector shape: `python tools/shape_filter.py --input logs.gz --dim 768`.

ben_ml: I'll add model-registry changelog entries and audit the quantize code path that returns 768 dims. If this is a legit mode we need to update reranker to accept both dims (or fail fast with more helpful errors).

eva_support: Writing the customer impact blurb: affected customers = 4 (enterprise), degrade window = ~15:13 - 15:26 UTC for majority; residual errors persisted until routing applied. No data loss. Sending draft to #customer-notifs.

dave_pm: I'll own the postmortem. We should include timeline, root cause, detection, mitigations, and follow-ups: (1) blockers in model compatibility testing, (2) per-model embedding-dim contract enforcement in runtime, (3) canary rollout safety checks. I'll create doc in Confluence and add owners.

alice_oncall: Handoff summary for next on-call (end of shift 16:00 UTC):
- System stable, error rate ~0.8%.
- Routing fallback remains at 30% until 16:30 to ensure no regressions.
- No further deploys to embedder until RCA complete.
- frank_eng to upload filtered traces; ben_ml to audit v3.7.1.

carol_sre: Quick follow-up: add a runtime metric for 'embed_dim_mismatch' so future occurrences alert before error-rate spike. I'll add a ticket.

frank_eng: Uploaded artifacts and sample payloads at s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1954321987/artifacts.tar.gz. Timeline notes in the archive:
- 15:04: deploy embedder:v3.7.1 rollout 40%
- 15:12: first 500s observed on rerank-batch-v1
- 15:16: paging & on-call notified
- 15:21: routing fallback applied (30%)
- 15:25: embedder rollback to 0%
- 15:27: error rate back to baseline for most traffic

alice_oncall: Thanks team. Next steps: dave_pm to publish postmortem draft with action items. carol_sre to create alert for embed_dim_mismatch. ben_ml to decide whether reranker should accept multiple dims or enforce strict contract. frank_eng to add pre-batch validation. I'll close the live incident channel once postmortem doc is linked. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident marked as 'mitigated' by alice_oncall at 2026-02-14T15:39:42Z. Follow-ups: create RCA doc and assign action owners.

alice_oncall: Leaving a note for the on-call takeover: if errors resurge, escalate to ben_ml + carol_sre immediately and revert routing to 0%.

dave_pm: I'll kick off postmortem and set a 48h SLA for initial draft. Assigning tasks in Asana now.

frank_eng: Adding two immediate engineering action items: 1) pre-batch vector shape validation (owner: frank_eng), 2) better canary gating for model rollouts (owner: ben_ml).

ben_ml: Also will add automated model-contract tests that run in CI when a model variant changes output dims.

alice_oncall: Thanks all. Ending live mitigation thread — please continue RCA discussion in the postmortem doc.
